intro.title: Agreement to terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Service («Terms») govern your access to https://www.watadiq.com and your use of websites, products, and professional services provided by WATAD Software («WATAD», «we», «us»).

By visiting our website, submitting an inquiry, creating an account where offered, or entering into a project agreement, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use our website or services.
These Terms form a binding agreement between you (or the organization you represent) and WATAD. You represent that you have authority to bind that organization when acting on its behalf.
Where a signed statement of work, master services agreement, proposal, or invoice terms conflict with these Terms, the signed or written project agreement prevails for that specific engagement.
We may provide translations of these Terms for convenience; the English version controls if there is a conflict unless local law requires otherwise.
These Terms are a general framework. Enterprise clients may negotiate master service agreements with additional security, insurance, or SLA commitments.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: WATAD is an Iraqi digital agency. Services include, without limitation:
bullets: Custom website design and development (marketing sites, dashboards, e-commerce, web apps).
Mobile application design and development for iOS and Android.
UI/UX design, design systems, and brand-aligned product interfaces.
Cybersecurity assessments, hardening guidance, secure architecture reviews, and related consulting.
Cloud deployment, DevOps support, hosting setup, and ongoing maintenance retainers.
API integrations, third-party service wiring, and performance optimization.
Training, documentation, and handover sessions for client teams where agreed.
Emergency support or remediation when contracted separately.
paragraphs: Detailed scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, and fees appear in your proposal, invoice, or signed agreement. We may update public service descriptions on watadiq.com without altering active contracts.
Beta features, internal tools, or experimental offerings may be labeled as such and provided without the same warranties as paid deliverables unless agreed in writing.

You are responsible for credentials, API keys, domains, and access you share with us.

bullets: Timelines depend on agreed scope, your timely feedback, and materials you supply (copy, brand assets, approvals).
Change requests outside scope may require a change order, revised fees, or new delivery dates.
We may use vetted subcontractors under confidentiality and need-to-know access.

Review periods for designs, staging sites, or builds are defined in your agreement; silence after the review window may count as acceptance where stated.
Third-party licenses (fonts, stock media, plugins, SaaS) may require your separate acceptance or payment.
Launch dates may depend on DNS, app store review, payment gateways, or other third parties outside our control.
projects.note: Delays caused by missing content, unavailable stakeholders, third-party outages, or force majeure extend schedules without penalty to WATAD.
paragraphs: We document major decisions in writing (email or project tools) to keep a clear record for both parties.
Post-launch warranty periods for bug fixes—if any—are defined in your agreement; new features are out of scope unless quoted.

payment.title: Fees & payment
bullets: Quotes are typically in Iraqi Dinar (IQD) unless another currency is stated in writing.
Accepted methods may include bank transfer, Zain Cash, or other channels published on our pricing page.
Deposits and milestone invoices are due on the dates shown; work may pause when accounts are overdue.
Late payments may incur reminders, suspension of work, or interest where permitted by law and stated on invoices.
Deposits and completed milestone work are generally non-refundable once work has started, except where law or your agreement says otherwise.
You are responsible for bank fees, currency conversion, and transfer charges on your side unless we agree otherwise.
Disputed invoices must be raised in writing within 14 days of receipt with specific reasons; undisputed portions remain due.
paragraphs: Excluded unless explicitly included: government fees, domain renewals, SSL where billed separately, ad spend, stock licenses, app store fees, SMS/voice costs, and pass-through SaaS subscriptions.
Taxes: you are responsible for applicable taxes unless we state we collect them on invoices.
Recurring retainers renew monthly or annually as stated on your invoice until cancelled per agreement notice periods.

You warrant that content you supply does not infringe trademarks, copyrights, privacy, or publicity rights of third parties.
Open-source components in deliverables remain subject to their licenses; we will flag major OSS dependencies when practical.
paragraphs: If you terminate early, rights to incomplete work are handled as stated in your agreement; otherwise WATAD may retain unfinished materials until outstanding fees are settled.

client.title: Your responsibilities
bullets: Provide timely feedback, approvals, and required content in agreed formats.
Ensure legal rights to logos, fonts, product data, user lists, and media you provide.
Maintain backups of live environments when we are not under a maintenance contract.
Comply with data protection laws for your end users; publish your own privacy policy where required.
Configure DNS, app store accounts, and merchant accounts promptly when those are on your side.
Do not ask us to implement deceptive patterns, illegal tracking, or malware.
Inform us of accessibility, language, or regulatory requirements before build starts when they affect architecture.
paragraphs: You indemnify WATAD against third-party claims arising from materials you supply or unlawful use of deliverables, except to the extent caused by our gross negligence or willful misconduct.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
paragraphs: Each party agrees to protect non-public business, technical, pricing, and roadmap information received from the other party.
Confidential information excludes data that is public without breach, independently developed, or rightfully received from a third party without duty of confidentiality.
We may disclose confidential information to employees, contractors, and advisers who need it to perform services, under matching confidentiality obligations.
If required by law, a party may disclose confidential information after giving notice when legally permitted so the other party may seek protective measures.

paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including lost profits, lost data, or business interruption.

WATAD's total aggregate liability for claims relating to a project or these Terms is limited to the fees you paid WATAD for that project in the twelve (12) months before the event giving rise to the claim, unless a higher cap is signed in your agreement.
These limits apply regardless of theory of liability (contract, tort, negligence, strict liability, or otherwise).
You acknowledge that pricing reflects these limitations and that WATAD would not provide services at current rates without them.

suspension.title: Suspension & termination
bullets: We may suspend website access, project work, or hosted environments if you breach these Terms, fail to pay, or misuse systems.
You may terminate according to cancellation terms in your signed agreement; otherwise written notice may be required with fees for work completed.
Upon termination, you pay for work performed, non-cancellable third-party costs, and any wind-down agreed in writing.
We may delete staging data after a reasonable period post-termination unless you purchase archive export.

paragraphs: If you migrate away from WATAD-managed hosting, we will provide reasonable transition assistance when contracted; emergency handover may require additional fees.

governing.title: Governing law & disputes
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Iraq, without regard to conflict-of-law rules that would apply another jurisdiction's laws.

Parties will first attempt good-faith resolution through direct negotiation. If unresolved within 30 days, disputes may be submitted to the competent courts in Iraq unless your signed agreement specifies arbitration or another forum.
You agree to bring claims only in your individual capacity unless we agree otherwise in writing.
Nothing prevents either party from seeking injunctive relief for misuse of IP or confidentiality breaches in any court with jurisdiction.

Material changes affecting active clients will be handled through project agreements or direct notice where appropriate.
Continued use of watadiq.com after changes take effect constitutes acceptance unless further consent is required by law.

forceMajeure.title: Force majeure
paragraphs: Neither party is liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond reasonable control (natural disasters, war, widespread outages, government actions, pandemics, major internet failures).
The affected party will notify the other and resume performance as soon as practicable.
